# Elan Exports Consultancy (EEC)

> Singapore Headquartered global sourcing and procurement consultancy connecting international buyers with verified manufacturers, with core expertise across India and Asia. Incorporated January 2025 (UEN: 202501728W).

EEC is a sourcing consultancy, not a marketplace or trading company. EEC charges buyers a service fee and works on open-book commercial terms; EEC does not charge suppliers listing or activation fees at any stage.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Elan Exports Consultancy Pte. Ltd.
- Headquarters: Singapore
- Incorporated: January 2025 (UEN 202501728W)
- Operations: India and Asia sourcing network, with buyers across Europe, the US, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific
- Contact: partners@eectrade.com

## What EEC does

EEC identifies, qualifies and audits manufacturers, then connects them with procurement teams for recurring sourcing programmes (not one-off spot RFQs). Every supplier is verified for IEC/GST registration, export history, and relevant compliance certifications before being introduced to a buyer.

## Engagement models

- Scout: fixed-fee, one-time project for buyers evaluating a new category or geography
- Engage: per-project engagement
- Embed: quarterly retainer, embedded sourcing arm for global buyers

## Active sourcing categories

1. Food Commodities (rice, sugar, pulses, edible oils, spices) — FSSAI, HACCP, BRC/BRCGS, amfori BSCI
2. Processed and Packaged Foods (snacks, beverages, frozen foods, ready meals) — BRC/BRCGS, FSSC 22000, amfori BSCI, IFS Food (Germany/France buyers)
3. Fresh and Agricultural Products (fruits, vegetables, organic produce) — GlobalG.A.P., GRASP, amfori BSCI, phytosanitary/MRL testing
4. Healthcare and Hospital Textile Supplies (patient gowns, scrubs, surgical drapes, hospital linen) — ISO 9001, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, BSCI
5. Home Textile, Apparel and Hospitality Products (bed linen, towels, uniforms, hotel textiles) — BSCI, SEDEX, GOTS, OEKO-TEX
6. Eco-Friendly, Sustainable and Organic Products (biodegradable packaging, organic textiles) — GOTS, EU Organic, NPOP
